goals.criterion: Complete the existing autonomous operating loop with independently verified session, continuation and actual runtime ownership

acceptance_criteria: Actual lowercase 40-hex Git tree and existing 64-hex tree plans register with exact release binding; no digest substitution.
Malformed trees and mismatched candidate trees refuse; policy_hash and other SHA256 digests remain strictly 64 hex.
Real disposable Git regression plus affected host-delivery/CLI/managed-runtime tests and Ruff pass; no runtime scope expansion.
